# Government Degree College Lakarai (GDC Lakarai)

> Government Degree College Lakarai (GDC Lakarai) is a public-sector
> higher-education institution located on Bajaur Express Road, Mohmand,
> Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Established in 2004, the college is
> affiliated with **Bacha Khan University, Charsadda** for its BS and AD
> programs, and affiliated with **BISE Peshawar** for its Intermediate
> (HSSC) programs.

## Programs Offered

### Intermediate (2-Year HSSC, BISE Peshawar)
- Pre-Engineering — Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry
- Pre-Medical — Biology, Physics, Chemistry
- ICS (Intermediate in Computer Science)
- Arts (Humanities) — Civics, History, Islamic Studies (plus optional)

### Associate Degree (AD) Programs — 2 Years (4 Semesters), HEC-recognized
- AD English
- AD Urdu
- AD Political Science

### BS Programs — 4 Years (8 Semesters), Affiliated with Bacha Khan University
- BS Urdu
- BS Zoology
- BS Botany
- BS Political Science
- BS Computer Science

## Admissions

- 1st Year (Intermediate Part-I): Requires Matriculation (SSC) result
- 2nd Year (Intermediate Part-II): Requires 1st Year pass / NOC
- AD Programs: Require Intermediate (HSSC) — any group, 2nd division
- BS Programs: Require Intermediate (HSSC) — see individual program pages
- BS Computer Science: Requires Intermediate with Mathematics

Apply online at https://gdclakarai.edu.pk/admission
